@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The nurse put the s______e into the bucket, and it quickly absorbed the water and swelled up.
= sponge
~詞義 sponge（n.）海綿
~原文 The nurse put the sponge into the bucket, and it quickly absorbed the water and swelled up.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: The house may look old from the outside, but its i______r is actually very modern.
= interior
~詞義 interior（n.）內部
~原文 The house may look old from the outside, but its interior is actually very modern.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: We told our friends about our plan for a Christmas party, and they were all very e______c about the idea.
= enthusiastic
~詞義 enthusiastic（adj.）熱情的
~原文 We told our friends about our plan for a Christmas party, and they were all very enthusiastic about the idea.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Each new r______t received training to prepare for the responsibilities of the rescue mission.
= recruit
~詞義 recruit（n.）新進人員
~原文 Each new recruit received training to prepare for the responsibilities of the rescue mission.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Tommy got the flu. He suffered from s______ms such as severe headache, coughing, and high fever.
= symptoms
~詞義 symptom（n.）症狀
~原文 Tommy got the flu. He suffered from symptoms such as severe headache, coughing, and high fever.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Animal ______ is not only cruel but also illegal and punishable by law.
A: calcium
B: abuse
C: stimulus
D: texture
= B
~詞義 abuse（n.）虐待
~原文 Animal abuse is not only cruel but also illegal and punishable by law.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The stadium is so ______ that it can house up to forty thousand people.
A: decent
B: federal
C: immense
D: mainstream
= C
~詞義 immense（adj.）巨大的
~原文 The stadium is so immense that it can house up to forty thousand people.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Doctors recommend that patients with ______ diseases do mild exercises regularly.
A: absurd
B: chronic
C: naive
D: beloved
= B
~詞義 chronic（adj.）慢性的
~原文 Doctors recommend that patients with chronic diseases do mild exercises regularly.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Dorothy loves to ______ in the bathtub and relax on cold winter nights.
A: abolish
B: stream
C: soak
D: steer
= C
~詞義 soak（v.）浸泡
~原文 Dorothy loves to soak in the bathtub and relax on cold winter nights.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: This morning, the ______ in my company building was under repair, so everyone had to take either the elevator or the stairs.
A: cathedral
B: escalator
C: lawmaker
D: sandal
= B
~詞義 escalator（n.）電扶梯
~原文 This morning, the escalator in my company building was under repair, so everyone had to take either the elevator or the stairs.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: stimulate
B: barren
C: belongings
D: deadly
E: supervise
F: removal

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: The scandal led to the minister's ______ from office. He was replaced by a much younger man.
= F
~詞義 removal（n.）免職
~原文 The scandal led to the minister's removal from office. He was replaced by a much younger man.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: Though the farmer has tried his best to grow crops on his land, the soil there is just too ______. No plants can grow well there.
= B
~詞義 barren（adj.）貧瘠的
~原文 Though the farmer has tried his best to grow crops on his land, the soil there is just too barren. No plants can grow well there.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: The government issued vouchers to all the citizens to ______ the economy.
= A
~詞義 stimulate（v.）刺激
~原文 The government issued vouchers to all the citizens to stimulate the economy.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: Don't forget to take your personal ______ with you. The room will soon be locked.
= C
~詞義 belongings（n.）所有物;行李
~原文 Don't forget to take your personal belongings with you. The room will soon be locked.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: This snake's poison is ______. Be careful not to step into its territory and get bitten.
= D
~詞義 deadly（adj.）致命的
~原文 This snake's poison is deadly. Be careful not to step into its territory and get bitten.

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Honesty and kindness are both great personality ______ that you should look for in a partner.
= A
~詞義 trait（n.）特點
~原文 Honesty and kindness are both great personality traits that you should look for in a partner.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: After three long years of war, the two countries finally reached an agreement and made a(n) ______ of peace.
= D
~詞義 declaration（n.）宣布
~原文 After three long years of war, the two countries finally reached an agreement and made a(n) declaration of peace.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The ______ of slavery marked a turning point in America's long struggles for equality and justice.
= B
~詞義 abolition（n.）廢止
~原文 The abolition of slavery marked a turning point in America's long struggles for equality and justice.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: The rain boots have thick rubber ______, and I like to wear them on rainy days because my feet don't get wet at all.
= E
~詞義 sole（n.）鞋底
~原文 The rain boots have thick rubber soles, and I like to wear them on rainy days because my feet don't get wet at all.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The hospital issued a birth ______ shortly after the child was safely delivered.
= C
~詞義 certificate（n.）證書
~原文 The hospital issued a birth certificate shortly after the child was safely delivered.
